findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pinpayments_list_charges, pinpayments_search_charges, pinpayments_list_customers, pinpayments_list_recipients, pinpayments_get_dispute_activity · Private data: pinpayments_search_charges, pinpayments_get_charge, pinpayments_list_charge_refunds, pinpayments_list_refunds, pinpayments_get_refund, pinpayments_get_authorisation, pinpayments_list_customers, pinpayments_get_customer, pinpayments_list_customer_charges, pinpayments_list_customer_cards, pinpayments_list_customer_subscriptions, pinpayments_get_deposit, pinpayments_search_transfers, pinpayments_get_transfer, pinpayments_list_transfer_line_items, pinpayments_get_recipient, pinpayments_list_recipient_transfers, pinpayments_search_disputes, pinpayments_get_dispute, pinpayments_get_dispute_activity, pinpayments_get_plan, pinpayments_list_plan_subscriptions, pinpayments_get_subscription, pinpayments_get_subscription_ledger, pinpayments_list_events, pinpayments_get_event · Public sink: pinpayments_list_charges, pinpayments_search_charges, pinpayments_list_customers, pinpayments_list_recipients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pinpayments_list_charges, pinpayments_search_charges, pinpayments_list_customers, pinpayments_list_recipients, pinpayments_get_dispute_activity · Private data: pinpayments_search_charges, pinpayments_get_charge, pinpayments_list_charge_refunds, pinpayments_list_refunds, pinpayments_get_refund, pinpayments_get_authorisation, pinpayments_list_customers, pinpayments_get_customer, pinpayments_list_customer_charges, pinpayments_list_customer_cards, pinpayments_list_customer_subscriptions, pinpayments_get_deposit, pinpayments_search_transfers, pinpayments_get_transfer, pinpayments_list_transfer_line_items, pinpayments_get_recipient, pinpayments_list_recipient_transfers, pinpayments_search_disputes, pinpayments_get_dispute, pinpayments_get_dispute_activity, pinpayments_get_plan, pinpayments_list_plan_subscriptions, pinpayments_get_subscription, pinpayments_get_subscription_ledger, pinpayments_list_events, pinpayments_get_event · Public sink: pinpayments_list_charges, pinpayments_search_charges, pinpayments_list_customers, pinpayments_list_recipients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
